en: Vintage sepia-toned multi‑view postcard. The picture side shows four small photographs: an elegant central European street with large classical buildings and a fountain or monument in front; a large modernist building on a hillside; a hillside landscape with a multi‑story building at the top and two men walking on a road in the foreground; and a garden or park scene with a small house or pavilion reached by steps among trees. At the bottom is printed Hungarian text reading "Üdvözlet Pécsről" (Greetings from Pécs). The reverse side has a handwritten message in blue ink in Hungarian, address lines, a red Hungarian stamp showing 'CSEPELI POSTAHIVATAL' and 'MAGYAR POSTA', and a circular postmark with 'VASAS'.
